## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

Closes #[Issue Number]

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (any changes to documentation in `docs/`)
- [ ] Refactor / Technical debt (non-breaking improvement to code structure)

## Verification Checklist

### 💻 Code & Build
- [ ] My code builds locally without errors.
- [ ] My changes do not introduce new linting errors or compilation warnings.
- [ ] I have written new unit/integration tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass successfully.

### 📂 Repository & Hygiene
- [ ] My branch naming follows conventions (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`).
- [ ] My commit messages follow conventional commit rules (`feat(...)`, `fix(...)`, `docs(...)`).
- [ ] There are no merge conflicts with the target branch.
- [ ] The change does not expose any credentials or local configuration files (`.env`).

### 📝 Documentation
- [ ] I have updated the Project Memory (`docs/Sprint Reports/Memory.md`) if necessary.
- [ ] I have updated related architecture, API specifications, or guides.
- [ ] I have documented any new configuration or environment variables.

## Screenshots / Code Diffs (if applicable)

Please attach any relevant screenshots, visual previews, or terminal output snippets to demonstrate correctness.
